system.description:
Elves are tremendous cooks and enjoy presenting bounteous feasts to their guests and relatives. This song mimics the arts of Cooking. Using this skill song along with Antiphon Union and the Lyric of Healing or the Doom of Strength allows the Elf to create Elven Bread.

FoRKs: Rhyme of Rules

Skill Type: Peasant. Tools: Yes. Expendable.

Restrictions: Elves only

Root: Per/Agi (§ magical skill: tests are open-ended)

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 298
